description: This file defines the CustomUserSettingsDisplayDriver class, a display driver for user settings in OrchardCore, handling editing and updating user-specific content types with authorization checks.

classes.name: CustomUserSettingsDisplayDriver
classes.description: A display driver for managing custom user settings, providing methods for editing and updating user-specific content types with authorization.

methods.name: EditAsync
methods.description: Handles the display of the user settings editing interface, generating content editors for each user setting type.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Processes updates to user settings, saving changes and re-displaying the editor.

methods.name: GetContentTypeDefinitionsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves content type definitions with the 'CustomUserSettings' stereotype.

methods.name: GetUserSettingsAsync
methods.description: Fetches or creates a ContentItem for user settings based on the user and content type.
